effect: The Markdown findings are useful leads but are not authority for Yui edits or new-candidate acceptance. No passing candidate may be overwritten and no quality gate opens from this artifact.

blocking_findings.detail: The 36 defective-card rows provide dwell seconds, reading-time seconds, and visible word counts but do not name the exact source files/hashes, extraction operation, execution time, card-state start/end derivation, tokenization rule, or machine-readable output. The 200 WPM value is stated as an assumption but is not separated from directly measured scalars.

The per-lane maximum near-unchanged runs (0.0 or 0.5 seconds) do not define decoded sampling rate, pixel metric, threshold, run-boundary algorithm, operation time, or evidence files. A label such as near-unchanged is not self-verifying.

The order requires headers, rails, banner language, colour semantics, visible card grammar, section naming, and end cards. The report covers only section taxonomy, internal storyboard data structure, and end-card structure. It does not adjudicate headers, rails, banner wording, colour-role semantics, or visible cross-lane card grammar.

The report treats structured params versus unstructured visual_action fields as card-grammar consistency. That is an implementation representation, not proof that encoded cards look or read consistently to viewers.

The recommendation that the four siblings are right relies on their majority/unified structure. It does not show that their nine-section taxonomy is semantically compatible with spin's distinct why-study/mirror story, nor bind the recommendation to Lana's claim-boundary veto.

requirements: Machine-readable per-card ledger with exact source paths and SHA-256 hashes, visible-text extraction definition, word-tokenization rule, start/end/dwell derivation, operation timestamp, and all intermediate scalars.
Explicitly distinguish measured values from the policy assumption of 200 WPM.
Motion receipt naming actual encoded MP4s, decode/sampling operation, frame rate, pixel-delta metric, threshold, run algorithm, timestamps, and per-lane evidence output.
Complete viewer-facing cross-lane matrix for headers, rails, banner wording, colour roles, visible card grammar, section names, and end cards.
For every 'which is right' decision, give viewer-facing and semantic rationale and bind claim-bearing changes to Lana's veto reference; do not choose by majority alone.
